title: Backspace String Compare
summary: Compare two strings s and t after applying backspace operations.
statement: Compare two strings s and t after applying backspace operations. Return true if the resulting strings are identical.
constraints: # deletes the preceding typed character when one exists.
Return whether both strings produce equal final text.
hints: Typing semantics are naturally represented by a stack of surviving characters.
Push letters; on # pop only when nonempty; compare final stacks.
The stack always equals the editor contents after the processed prefix.
editorial: The stack always equals the editor contents after the processed prefix.
